sources.title: Montgomery County Election Summary Report, Closed Primary May 19, 2026 (pages marked OFFICIAL RESULTS, 6/8/2026), with appended Notice Concerning Offices Eligible for Write-in Adjudication

notes: Each of 428 precincts has a "Republican Committeeperson (Vote for 2)" contest, so seats are labelled "Committeeperson". The file name says "Unofficial", but its pages are marked OFFICIAL RESULTS and dated 6/8/2026. The appended county notice lists the leading write-in candidate for each office eligible for write-in adjudication, with a 10-vote minimum for committeeperson, and says offices not listed did not qualify. Filled = a ballot candidate in the top two with more than the write-in total, or with any votes where no write-in was listed for the precinct. Empty = an open seat with no ballot candidate and no listed write-in. Unknown = a seat tied to a listed write-in (72 rows), because the county says it is still verifying write-in winners' eligibility. The precinct count (428) differs from the 426 in war_map/counties.geojson.
